what: PBF Energy refines crude oil into petrol, diesel and jet fuel at six American refineries on the East and Gulf Coasts and in California, and holds a stake in a renewable diesel joint venture.
customers: Fuel distributors, airlines and wholesale buyers across the United States.
money: petrol, diesel, jet fuel and other products
pipelines and terminals serving its refineries
moat: Refineries cannot be built in America any more: the permitting is effectively impossible, so existing capacity is a scarce asset whatever the margin cycle does.
risks: Refining margins are volatile and set by the spread between crude and product prices
A fire at the Martinez refinery in California cut output and cost money
Revenue fell from $46.8B to $29.3B as crack spreads normalised
opportunities: 2.7 times earnings and 2.0 times EBITDA: among the lowest valuations in American refining
$2.6B of free cash flow against a $7.5B market value
Analysts see about 36% upside, and no new American refining capacity is being built
watch: Refining margins per barrel and the Martinez refinery's return to full rates.
